hero.headline:
Gluten-free life,
told exactly as it is.
hero.body: Mother. Programmer. And for a few years now, an involuntary expert in reading labels. Here I talk about coeliac disease with no jargon and no sugar-coating — with just the right mix of useful and fed up that comes from asking "does this contain traces?" in every single restaurant.

about.title: From programmer to accidental advocate.
about.body: I was diagnosed with coeliac disease in 2018 and found out nobody explains what living with it is actually like: the packed lunch at every plan, the interrogation over every menu, and that feeling of being "the difficult one" in the group. I started posting about it on Instagram with humour because, if I don't laugh, nobody does.
